identity.title: List of Japanese language Pokémon movie home video releases

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of the Pokémon movies and their accompanying Pikachu shorts in Japan.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of the Pokémon movies and their accompanying Pikachu shorts in Japan.

==Single movie releases==

===Revelation-Lugia===
 

===Lord of the "Unknown" Tower===
 

===Celebi: a Timeless Encounter===
 

===The Guardians of Altomare===
 

===Wishing Star of the Seven Nights===
 

===Deoxys the Visitor===
 

===Mew and the Wave Hero===
 

===The Pokémon Ranger and The Prince of the Sea===
 

===Dialga VS Palkia VS Darkrai===
 

===Giratina and the Sky's Bouquet: Shaymin===
 

===Arceus: To a Conquering Spacetime===
 

===Supreme Ruler of Illusions: Zoroark===
 

===Victini and the Black Hero: Zekrom and Victini and the White Hero: Reshiram===

===Kyurem VS the Sacred Swordsman: Keldeo===
 

===ExtremeSpeed Genesect: Mewtwo Awakens===
 

===The Cocoon of Destruction and Diancie===
 

===The Archdjinni of the Rings: Hoopa===
 

===Volcanion and the Mechanical Magearna===
 

===I Choose You!===
 

===Everyone's Story===
 

===Mewtwo Strikes Back Evolution===
 

==Multi-movie releases==
===Pikachu the Movie Box 1998-2002===

===Pikachu the Movie Box 2003-2006===

===Pikachu the Movie Box 2007-2010===

===Pikachu the Movie Premium Box 1998-2010===
This set was released exclusively on Blu-ray on November 28, 2012. This fourteen disc set contains high-definition remasters of the first thirteen Pokémon movies, as well as the first, second, fourth, and fifth Pikachu shorts: the third short, Pichu & Pikachu was not included due to the arrest of Sakai Noriko in 2009.

===ExtremeSpeed Genesect: Mewtwo Awakens - Mewtwo Special Pack===
Released alongside the singular DVD and Blu-ray versions of ExtremeSpeed Genesect: Mewtwo Awakens, this three-disc DVD set features the aformentioned movie, alongside Mewtwo - Prologue to its Awakening, Mewtwo Strikes Back and Pikachu's Summer Vacation, Mewtwo! I Am Here!, and the Pokémon the Series episode Tokiwa Gym! The Last Badge!.
